mechanism: Voluntary model tariff; each utility adopts it through its own tariff filing
utilities_covered: All electric distribution companies, as guidance
size_threshold: Over 50 MW individually or 100 MW in aggregate; utilities may apply it below 50 MW
contract_term: Load ramp period plus a minimum initial term of 5 years
load_ramp: Load ramp schedule set in the contract
exit_terms: 48 months' notice for termination or major capacity reduction
collateral: Enough to cover network improvement and interconnection facilities costs; reduced or refunded as milestones are met
costs_assigned: Interconnection and infrastructure costs of serving the customer
regulator_review: PUC reviews each utility's tariff filing
status_2026: Model adopted; utilities adopting through their own filings. HB 2828, which cleared the House Energy Committee in September 2026, would require utilities to adopt it

mechanism: New GS-5 rate class in Dominion Energy Virginia's rates
decision_and_date: Final order Nov. 25, 2025 (Case PUR-2025-00058); effective Jan. 1, 2027
minimum_bill: 85% of contracted transmission and distribution demand; 60% of contracted generation demand
load_ramp: Up to 4 years, adding at least 20% of contracted demand each year
exit_terms: Exit fees to recover remaining contract costs on early termination
collateral: $1.5 million per MW of contracted demand, reducible by up to 70% for strong credit and released over the contract term
costs_assigned: Transmission, distribution, and generation, through minimum charges
regulator_review: Terms set in the utility's rate case
status_2026: Approved; takes effect Jan. 1, 2027. In August 2026, the SCC ordered Dominion to develop a tariff assigning more transmission costs to data centers

mechanism: Data center tariff for one utility, approved as a settlement
size_threshold: New or expanded data center load over 25 MW; mobile data centers over 1 MW
minimum_bill: Up to 85% of contract capacity, on a sliding scale by size
exit_terms: Exit fee equal to three years of minimum charges, or three years' notice after the initial period
collateral: Customers below set credit standards post collateral equal to 50% of total minimum charges; surety bonds not accepted
costs_assigned: Subscribed capacity, regardless of actual use
regulator_review: Approved by PUCO as a tariff
status_2026: In effect; Ohio Manufacturers' Association appeal pending at the Ohio Supreme Court. Substitute HB 646 would create a statewide data center rate class

mechanism: Statute requires large-load tariffs; utility tariffs pending before the PSC
utilities_covered: BGE, Delmarva Power, and Pepco filed jointly; the statute also covers Potomac Edison
decision_and_date: Next Generation Energy Act (SB 937, Chapter 625), signed May 20, 2025, first required large-load rate schedules; Utility RELIEF Act (HB 1532), enacted May 12, 2026, lowered the thresholds; utility tariff filed Sept. 29, 2026
size_threshold: 25 MW aggregate monthly demand (lowered from 100 MW in the 2025 Next Generation Energy Act)
load_factor: 60% (lowered from over 80% in the 2025 Next Generation Energy Act)
costs_assigned: The PSC is directed to consider cost-allocation approaches for large-load customers. The 2025 act also lets the PSC assign specified costs to co-location arrangements in which a large customer takes power directly from a generating station without using the grid.
status_2026: Statute in effect; tariff terms pending
items_to_verify: Terms proposed in the Sept. 29 utility filing; whether Potomac Edison has filed

mechanism: PSC rule allowing customized contracts for Georgia Power's largest customers
contract_term: Up to 15 years under the rule (previously 5); Georgia Power testified its contracts run 15 years or longer
exit_terms: Early termination penalties set in each contract
collateral: Letters of credit or other collateral, per Georgia Power testimony
costs_assigned: Upstream generation, transmission, and distribution costs, plus site-specific costs
regulator_review: Contracts filed with the PSC at least 30 days before signing; quarterly reports on new large loads
status_2026: In effect; Public Service Commission elections Nov. 3, 2026
